select.purpose: Let people choose valid operational values while preserving label, selected value, source, loading, recovery, keyboard behavior, and responsive option access.
select.referenceRationale: Adopt the richer reference behavior for stateful selects, but translate visuals, spacing, typography, motion, and option semantics through Design System foundations and primitives.

anatomy.rule: Owns label, helper, validation, and disabled/loading relationship.
Exposes current value and opens the option layer.
Visible selected option remains the accessible value summary.
Popover or sheet presents options, groups, disabled reasons, and active option.
Explains source, freshness, validation, or recovery.

variants.use: Compact Select trigger embedded inside another field surface, such as Phone Input country code.

select.statePrecedence: disabled > loading > error > open > focus > filled > default

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label and accessible name source.

props.name: options
props.description: Options with stable value, label, helper, disabled reason, and metadata.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading Material Symbol for the selected domain.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Explains what kind of entity is expected.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows progress and prevents misleading stale options.

props.name: error
props.description: Visible recovery copy associated with the field.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and explains permission or availability.

props.name: density
props.description: Maps the trigger and option rhythm to Design System Density.

props.name: state
props.description: Documents the visual and interaction state of the single-select field.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Emits semantic value, selected option, source, and analytics metadata.

productExamples.example: Fleet Select filters dashboard, URL state, analytics, and table queries.
Vehicle Select stays a field trigger; long, grouped, or searchable option journeys escalate to a pattern.
Unavailable options explain disabled reason instead of disappearing.

do: Keep label, value, helper text, and source visible.
Escalate long or searchable option journeys to a pattern.
Show disabled reasons inside unavailable options.
dont: Do not use Select for free-form input.
Do not hide loading or permission states.
Do not expose raw option data without labels.
info: Searchable and multi-select behavior become patterns when they sequence more than one decision.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: sheet or stacked field with full-width trigger
inline filters and popovers with visible helper text
larger filter surfaces and inspector panels

tests: Renders label, selected value, helper text, and combobox/listbox semantics.
Opens by click, Enter, Space, and ArrowDown.
Restores focus after selection, cancel, Escape, or outside click.
Announces loading, empty, error, disabled, and permission-blocked states.
agentInstructions: Use Select only for valid options, not free-form input.
Preserve label, value, helper, source, and recovery copy.
Ask before making searchable, multi-select, or product-system behavior.
rejectIf: Label or helper text is missing.
Options do not have stable value and label.
Disabled or loading state is only visual.
Raw color, spacing, radius, or motion bypasses tokens.
